title: TimePicker
description: Picks a time of day from hour, minute and second columns, or by typing it.

keyboard.title: Keyboard and accessibility
keyboard.open: Arrow Down on the input opens the panel; clicking outside closes it.
keyboard.navigate: Each column (Hours, Minutes, Seconds, AM/PM) is a listbox: Arrow Up / Arrow Down, Home and End move within it, Arrow Left / Arrow Right switch columns.
keyboard.select: Enter or Space picks the focused option.
keyboard.close: Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the input. Tab past the last column closes it and moves on to the next field; Shift+Tab before the first column closes it and returns to the input.
keyboard.typing: Typed text is committed only once it is a complete, valid time. On blur a more lenient parse is applied; empty text clears the value and unparsable text restores the previous one.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected time (controlled; pair with onChange). `null` means "no time" while staying controlled; `undefined` makes the picker uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected time (uncontrolled)

props.name: format
props.description: Display format: "HH:mm:ss", "HH:mm", "hh:mm:ss a" or "hh:mm a"

props.name: use12Hours
props.description: Uses a 12-hour clock with an AM/PM column

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the input

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label of the input; without it the input is labelled "Time" (localized)

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label of the input when no visible label is shown

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id(s) of the element(s) labelling the input; inside a FormControl it defaults to the FormLabel (unless `label` / `aria-label` is set)

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Id(s) of the element(s) describing the input; merged with the helper / error text of an enclosing FormControl

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the input; defaults to the id of an enclosing FormControl

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input as required; defaults to the enclosing FormControl's state

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the value without allowing changes (typing, panel, clearing); defaults to the enclosing FormControl's state

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the input as invalid (aria-invalid); defaults to the enclosing FormControl's state

props.description: Name of the input

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the picker; defaults to the enclosing FormControl's state

props.description: Allows clearing the value with the suffix button

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Click the input (or press Arrow Down) to open the panel. onChange receives a Date, or undefined when cleared. Without label, the input is named "Time".

examples.title: Controlled
examples.description: Pass value and update it in onChange. null keeps the picker controlled but empty, while undefined makes it uncontrolled. label gives the input a visible label.

examples.title: Default value and clearing
examples.description: defaultValue sets the initial time. The clear button is labelled "Clear time"; set clearable={false} to hide it.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled picker cannot be opened or edited.

examples.title: Formats
examples.description: Supported formats are HH:mm:ss and HH:mm (plus their 12-hour variants). Hide the seconds column with showSecond={false}.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Three sizes: small, medium (default) and large.

examples.title: Steps
examples.description: hourStep, minuteStep and secondStep set the interval between options.

examples.title: Time range
examples.description: minTime and maxTime disable the options outside the allowed range.

examples.title: 12-hour clock
examples.description: use12Hours adds an AM/PM column; combine it with the hh:mm:ss a or hh:mm a format.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Type a time or pick it from the panel. The value attribute sets the initial time; minerva-change fires when a time is committed, and valueAsDate returns it as a Date.

formats.title: Formats, sizes and states
formats.description: format and use-12-hours control the display (hide-second hides the seconds column when the format has none); three sizes; read-only, disabled and invalid states.

range-steps.title: Range and steps
range-steps.description: min-time and max-time disable options outside the range; hour-step, minute-step and second-step space the options.

form.title: In a form
form.description: The element is form-associated: it submits a 24-hour value under name, required blocks an empty field, and form.reset() restores the value attribute.

props.readOnly: Shows the value without allowing changes (typing, panel, clearing).
props.hideClearButton: Hides the clear button (clearable={false} in React).
props.hideSecond: Hides the seconds column (showSecond={false} in React).
props.valueAsDate: The value as a Date (today's date), null when empty or invalid.
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled (itself or by a disabled <fieldset>).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element.
props.validationMessage: Message describing the current validation error (empty when valid).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation.

events.minerva-change: The time was committed (picked, typed, normalized on blur or cleared), detail: { value } ("" when cleared).
events.minerva-input: The text of the input changed while typing, detail: { value } (the typed text).
events.minerva-open-change: The user opened or closed the panel, detail: { open }; cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.
events.minerva-clear: The clear button emptied the field.

cssVars.--input-height: Minimum height of the field (defaults to the density's control height for the size).
cssVars.--input-radius: Corner radius of the field (defaults to --radius-lg).
cssVars.--input-focus-color: Border color while hovered or focused.
cssVars.--icon-button-color: Color of the clear button icon.
cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: Background of the clear button on hover.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of the clear button while pressed.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-bg: Background of the clear button while pressed.
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the clear button (defaults follow the density's control heights).
cssVars.--icon-button-icon-size: Size of the clear button icon.
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the clear button (defaults to --radius-lg).

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner input.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the value is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error (an empty string clears it).
methods.formResetCallback: Called by the browser on form.reset(): restores the value attribute.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Called by the browser when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Called by the browser to restore the value (back/forward cache, autofill).
